Educational and Experience RequirementsÂ

  • 5+ years of experience in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology companies.Â

🛠️ About our Technical Operations Teams

 

Wayve’s Technical Operations function is the critical bridge between Product, Engineering, and Operations. We thrive in dynamic, high-growth environments, turning complex technical strategies into actionable field operations that set the standard for autonomy at scale.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

You’ll stand up and run technical operations in new markets—planning data collection campaigns, preparing vehicles and operators for launch, and running live robotaxi services with our ridehail partners. Your work will build the feedback loops that convert on-road data, operator insights, and service metrics into continuous product enhancements, demonstrating improvements through live operations. You’ll drive the pace and reliability required to deliver commercial services where customer experience and operational reliability are measured daily.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Market launch readiness: Turn program plans into clear, actionable launch plans by market, covering vehicle commissioning, operator readiness, route and ODD validation, and safety sign-offs. Lead go/no-go reviews across multiple regions.

  • Third-party operator performance: Manage operating relationships with subcontracted partners, set and review SLAs and performance standards, run audit cycles, and drive corrective actions.

  • Operator standards and train-the-trainer: Partner with Training to ensure trainers are certified, curricula keep pace with releases, and operator competence is consistently assessed in every market.

  • Release and change management: Coordinate how software and model releases reach the road, from operator briefings and in-car checks to staged rollouts and structured field feedback.

  • Performance reporting: Own weekly product performance reporting—including autonomy time, pickups/drop-offs, km driven, and safety events—and turn trends into priority actions for Operations, Engineering, and Product.

  • Field-to-model feedback loops: Be the link between on-road operations and model, product, and research teams. Triage on-road events, route insights, and design targeted testing to close data gaps.

  • Scaling the playbook: Improve processes, SOPs, and tooling so each new market launches faster and more safely.

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

Essential:

  • Experience in technical program management or operations roles at the intersection of R&D, product development, and field testing in high-complexity environments (e.g., autonomous systems, robotics, aerospace, advanced mobility).

  • Proven track record of managing programs, demonstrations, or operations that require close coordination between technical development teams and field execution.

  • Deep experience with test planning, operational readiness frameworks, and structured field-to-technical feedback loops.

  • Ability to influence across teams and geographies in fast-moving technology environments.

  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with experience leading cross-functional workshops and coordinating across Engineering, Science, Product, and Operations.

  • Clear written communication, including SOPs, launch checklists, and executive updates.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities.

  • Willing to travel up to 30% across launch markets.

 

Desirable:

  • Experience in autonomous vehicles, advanced driver assistance systems, or rideshare/mobility marketplace operations.

  • Background in safety management systems, incident investigation or operator competence frameworks.

  • Experience with AV permitting or deployment in one or more markets.

  • Comfortable with project management tools (e.g., Confluence, Asana/Jira) and implementing operational tracking systems.

  • Knowledge of process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) or operational excellence frameworks.

  • Familiarity with vehicle commissioning, fleet management systems, or automotive safety protocols.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

 

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 

Initial call / recruiter screen - 30 mins

 

Competency Interviews - 45 mins

 

Deep-dive technical interviews - Case Study Presentation - 1 hour

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
